
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper21" title="发布于 2026-04-03 08:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MAF快速入门（21）RC5引入的Script运行能力</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202604/381412-20260402193331958-1626111220.png" alt="MAF快速入门（21）RC5引入的Script运行能力" class="desc_img">
        本文介绍了RC5引入的令人激动的script执行能力，有了script执行能力，Agent Skill才变得更加完整，也从静态知识包 开始走向 可执行能力包，Agent Skill = 知识 + 资源 + 脚本。从RC5也可以看到，MAF对Skill的理解也在不断地进化，开始往软件工程层面迈进！
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>最近我一直在跟着圣杰的《<span>.NET+AI智能体开发进阶<span>》课程学习MAF开发多智能体工作流，我强烈推荐你也上车跟我一起出发！</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper20" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2"><span>上一篇</span></a><span>，我们<span>了解下.NET 10新推出的File-Based App模式，它和MAF一起可以形成一个强大的“王牌组合”。而就在这两天，<strong>MAF 1.0.0-rc5</strong>发布了，之前github demo中的agent skills demo也可以运行了！有了script执行能力，skill的拼图终于完整了，我也相信GA版本就快到来了！</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>1 RC5的新变化</strong></h1>
<p><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>在RC5之前，我们使用Skills的方式还主要是静态知识注入，一方面解决如何让Agent知道领域知识，另一方面让Agent通过渐进式披露策略降低Token消耗。而至于script能力，MAF一直为开放，而前面的内容，圣杰也给出了一个思路。但是到了RC5，官方实现来了，别激动，请接住！</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>Skill的定位变化</span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<p><span>有了script的运行能力，<strong>skill</strong><span><strong>从 静态知识包 开始走向 可执行能力包</strong>，其新增的接口 run_skill_script 就是来执行script的入口。</span></span></p>
<p><span>根据之前的了解，现在AgentSkillProvider就能有三个接口来构建Skill了：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>load_skill</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>read_skill_resource</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>run_skill_script</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span>因此，我们对Agent Skills的定义也会更加完善：</span></p>
<p><span>即&nbsp;<strong>Agent Skill = 指令 + 资源 + 脚本 共同组成的可移植能力包</strong></span></p>
<h3><span><span>MAF Skills的4层架构</span></span></h3>
<p><span>从MAF对Skills的实现来看，它做了较多的抽象 和 工程化，基本可以拆分为4层，如下图所示：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202604/381412-20260402192706341-2034786969.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span><span>1.&nbsp;<span>对象层<span>：定义 Skill 是什么</span></span></span></span></li>
<li><span><span>2.&nbsp;<span>Source 层<span>：定义 Skill 从哪里来</span></span></span></span></li>
<li><span><span>3.&nbsp;<span>Decorator 层<span>：定义 Skill 怎么过滤、去重、组合</span></span></span></span></li>
<li><span><span>4.&nbsp;<span>Provider 层<span>：定义 Skill 怎么进入 Agent 运行时</span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span><span>更多地解析推荐大家阅读圣杰的《<a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIwMDM3MjcxOQ==&amp;mid=2458777625&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=33b27cc8c7b219798331d43f902e24bc&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow"><span>MAF悄悄更新到RC5，Agent Skills的脚本运行能力Ready了</span></a><span>》，这里我就不再重复了，下面我们具体看看DEMO。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span><span>Code as Skill ： 代码定义Skill</span></span></h3>
<p><span>在RC5中，支持在代码中定义Skill，而不再限制于目录中的markdown文档，在Source层，它叫做 AgentInMemorySkillsSource。下面也会给出一个例子展示这个代码定义Skill的模式。</span></p>
<h1><strong><span>2 快速开始：单位转换器<strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;6 3 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-top: 16px;margin-bottom: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;color: rgb(0, 179, 139);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Lantinghei SC\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Yahei\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Sans Serif\&quot;, \&quot;WenQuanYi Micro Hei\&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.544px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></strong></span></strong></h1>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">这里我们直接来看官方团队给出的案例：单位转换器。虽然，这个案例有点脱了裤子放屁的意思，但是足够简单和覆盖知识点。</p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>我们希望创建一个单位转换的Agent，能够通过查询skill及其相关计算规则 和 运行脚本 回复用户关于单位转换的结果。</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>老规矩，我们先写Skill的内容：SKILL.md，references 和 scripts。</span></span></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><span><span>SKILL.md</span></span></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">首先，我们创建这个SKILL.md，内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>---
name: unit-converter
description: 使用乘法换算系数在常见单位之间进行转换。在需要将英里/公里、磅/千克等单位互相换算时使用。
---

## 使用方法

当用户请求单位换算时：
1. 先查看 `references/conversion-table.md`，找到正确的换算系数
2. 使用 `--value &lt;数值&gt; --factor &lt;系数&gt;` 运行 `scripts/convert.py` 脚本（例如：`--value 26.2 --factor 1.60934`）
3. 输出内容需要清晰地展示换算系数、换算过程和换算结果，并同时标明换算前后的两个单位</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>reference: 转换公式表</span></span></strong></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>其次，我们创建一个conversion-table.md，用于告诉Agent转换的系数和公式：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># Conversion Tables（换算表）

Formula（公式）: **result = value × factor（结果 = 数值 × 系数）**

&gt; Note（说明）:
&gt; - `From` / `To` 列请保持英文（miles, kilometers, pounds, kilograms），便于在工具参数/代码中稳定引用。
&gt; - 中文列仅用于阅读理解。

| From       | To         | Factor   | From (中文) | To (中文) |
|------------|------------|----------|------------ |----------|
| miles      | kilometers | 1.60934  | 英里        | 千米/公里 |
| kilometers | miles      | 0.621371 | 千米/公里   | 英里     |
| pounds     | kilograms  | 0.453592 | 磅          | 千克/公斤 |
| kilograms  | pounds     | 2.20462  | 千克/公斤   | 磅       |</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>scripts: 可执行脚本</span></span></strong></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>这里我们编写了一个python脚本 convert.py 来做一个简单的运算，虽然它太简单了：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单位换算脚本</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">

<h3 data-pm-slice="3 3 []"><strong><span><span>自定义脚本执行器</span></span></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">这里，官方定义了一个ScriptRunner，它会通过一个本地进程来执行Skill中的脚本，也就是上面的 convert.py 代码脚本。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SubprocessScriptRunner
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Runs a skill script as a local subprocess.
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RunAsync(
        AgentFileSkill skill,
        AgentFileSkillScript script,
        AIFunctionArguments arguments,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">File.Exists(script.FullPath))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error: Script file not found: {script.FullPath}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> extension =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path.GetExtension(script.FullPath);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? interpreter = extension <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.py</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.js</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">node</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.sh</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bash</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.ps1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pwsh</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            _ </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        };

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> startInfo = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessStartInfo
        {
            RedirectStandardOutput </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            RedirectStandardError </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            UseShellExecute </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            CreateNoWindow </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            WorkingDirectory </span>= Path.GetDirectoryName(script.FullPath) ?? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        };

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (interpreter <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            startInfo.FileName </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interpreter;
            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add(script.FullPath);
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            startInfo.FileName </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.FullPath;
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (arguments <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> (key, value) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> arguments)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (value <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> boolValue)
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (boolValue)
                    {
                        startInfo.ArgumentList.Add(NormalizeKey(key));
                    }
                }
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (value <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                {
                    startInfo.ArgumentList.Add(NormalizeKey(key));
                    startInfo.ArgumentList.Add(value.ToString()</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                }
            }
        }

        Process</span>? process = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            process </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Process.Start(startInfo);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (process <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error: Failed to start process for script '{script.Name}'.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            Task</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; outputTask =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(cancellationToken);
            Task</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; errorTask =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(cancellationToken);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> process.WaitForExitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> output = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> outputTask.ConfigureAwait(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> error = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> errorTask.ConfigureAwait(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
            {
                output </span>+= $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\nStderr:\n{error}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (process.ExitCode != <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                output </span>+= $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\nScript exited with code {process.ExitCode}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.IsNullOrEmpty(output) ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(no output)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> : output.Trim();
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Kill the process on cancellation to avoid leaving orphaned subprocesses.</span>
            process?.Kill(entireProcessTree: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error: Failed to execute script '{script.Name}': {ex.Message}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            process</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Dispose();
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Normalizes a parameter key to a consistent --flag format.
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Models may return keys with or without leading dashes (e.g., "value" vs "--value").
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> NormalizeKey(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> key) =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + key.TrimStart(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pm-slice="3 3 []">可以看到，在该Runner中定义了一些基本的校验规则，然后就通过启动一个本地进程去执行脚本。</p>

<h1 data-pm-slice="5 3 []"><strong><span>3 快速开始：代码定义Skills<strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;6 3 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-top: 16px;margin-bottom: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;color: rgb(0, 179, 139);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Lantinghei SC\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Yahei\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Sans Serif\&quot;, \&quot;WenQuanYi Micro Hei\&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.544px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></strong></span></strong></h1>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">这里我们再来看看官方的第二个DEMO：<strong>通过代码定义Skills</strong>，这里就会用到&nbsp;AgentInlineSkill 这个新增对象。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> unitConverterSkill = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentInlineSkill(
    name: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">unit-converter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    description: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">使用乘法换算系数在常见单位之间进行转换。在需要将英里/公里、磅/千克等单位互相换算时使用。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    instructions: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        当用户请求单位换算时，请使用本 Skill。

        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. 查看 `conversion-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">table` 资源，找到正确的换算系数。
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. 查看 `conversion-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">policy` 资源，了解取整和格式化规则。
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 使用 `convert` 脚本，并传入从表中查到的数值和系数。
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 静态资源: conversion tables</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    .AddResource(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">conversion-table</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        # 换算表

        公式: </span>**结果 = 数值 × 系数**

        | From        | To          | Factor   |
        |-------------|-------------|----------|
        | miles       | kilometers  | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.60934</span>  |
        | kilometers  | miles       | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.621371</span> |
        | pounds      | kilograms   | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.453592</span> |
        | kilograms   | pounds      | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.20462</span>  |
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 动态资源: conversion policy (运行时计算)</span>
    .AddResource(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">conversion-policy</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Precision = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            # 换算策略

            </span>**小数位数:**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {Precision}
            </span>**格式:**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 始终同时显示原始值、换算后值以及单位
            </span>**生成时间:**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {DateTime.UtcNow:O}
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    })
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 代码脚本: convert by C# code</span>
    .AddScript(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">convert</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> value, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> factor) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> result = Math.Round(value * factor, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> JsonSerializer.Serialize(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> { value, factor, result });
    });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> skillsProvider = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AgentSkillsProvider(unitConverterSkill);</pre>
</div>
<p>可以看到，MAF释放的信号很明确：<strong>Skill不只是磁盘中的markdown文件！Code as Skill!</strong></p>
<p>那么，这类型的动态skill适合哪些场景呢？</p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>答案：它特别适合那些<strong><span><span>只存在于运行时</span></span></strong><span><span>的信息，比如：</span></span></span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span><span>当前租户配置；</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>当前区域；</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>实时配额；</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>当前系统状态；</span></span></li>
<li><span><span>动态生成的业务规则。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>这些信息如果硬要放到磁盘中形成文件，反而不自然。</span></span></p>
<h1><span><span><strong><span>4 小结</span></strong></span></span></h1>
<p>本文介绍了RC5引入的令人激动的script执行能力，有了script执行能力，Agent Skill才变得更加完整，也<strong>从</strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: left;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><strong>静态知识包 开始走向 可执行能力包，Agent Skill = 知识 + 资源 + 脚本</strong>。</span></p>
<p>由此也可见，MAF对Skill的理解也在不断地进化，开始往软件工程层面迈进！</p>
<p>不过，要真的走上生产环境，还需要在应用层面考虑安全性 和 扩展性方面的内容，毕竟企业级应用还是得控制风险！</p>
